title: Deep-learning-guided electrochemistry identifies a mechanistic outlier in cobalt–organohalide reactions
summary: A UCLA-led team combined a ResNet voltammogram classifier with Bayesian experiment selection to investigate cobalt tetraphenylporphyrin reactions. The workflow flagged 4-chlorobutyronitrile as departing from the expected electron-transfer–chemical-reaction mechanism; additional manual measurements confirmed the anomaly. An alternative radical pathway remains a hypothesis. This is a laboratory proof of concept, not a general-purpose mechanistic oracle. The date records the journal version.
ai_technology: ResNet cyclic-voltammetry classifier; Bayesian optimization; Gaussian-process response modeling
organization: University of California, Los Angeles; University of Illinois Urbana–Champaign; University of Utah; Université Grenoble Alpes

evidence.tested: Automated cyclic voltammetry followed by manual confirmation of the unexpected substrate behavior.
evidence.unknown: The proposed alternative pathway is not established. Supplementary material was not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: Learned mechanism probabilities guided experiments and flagged the outlier; people performed the confirming measurements and interpretation.

source_review.scope: Final-paper full text, including Results, Discussion and main Methods, via author institutional PDF; PubMed bibliographic record. Supplement and raw data not reviewed.
